# `<list.h>`

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Intrusive circular doubly linked list with a sentinel head.

```c
#include <list.h>
```

## Constants

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="list_for_each_safe"></a>`LIST_FOR_EACH_SAFE(pos, n, head)` |  | Walks a list with `n` holding the next node, so `pos` may be removed. |
| <a id="list_for_each"></a>`LIST_FOR_EACH(pos, head)` |  | Walks a list from `head's` sentinel; `pos` must not be removed. |
| <a id="list_head_init"></a>`LIST_HEAD_INIT(name)` |  | Static initializer for an empty [ListHead](#listhead) named `name`. |
| <a id="container_of"></a>`container_of(ptr, type, member)` |  | Gets the object of type `type` that embeds `ptr` as its field `member`. |
